items.title: Free Laptop Yojana 2026: फ्री लैपटॉप योजना 2026 Registration,Last Date & Latest Update
items.snippet_en: There is no permanent national scheme providing free laptops to all students. Messages claiming a "PM Free Laptop Yojana" for every student are usually fake forwards.

items.title: Did Government of India invite applications for free laptops? PIB Fact Check debunks social media posts
items.snippet_en: The PIB Fact Check unit debunked social media posts claiming the "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026" was inviting applications for free laptops, clarifying that the Government of India has not announced any such scheme.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Careerindia.com warns against a viral WhatsApp message about a "Free Laptop Scheme 2026," calling it a scam. It states that no all-India laptop grant exists this year.

items.title: प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना की फर्जी खबरों के बारे में जागरूकता
items.snippet_en: The AICTE website has a notice titled "Awareness about fake news of Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme," indicating that claims about a PM Free Laptop Scheme are false.
A YouTube video by TV9 Bharatvarsh investigates the "Students Laptop Scheme 2026" and concludes that the claim of the government providing free laptops to all students under this scheme is fake.

Yojanagpt.com clarifies that the Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is a set of state-level programs, not a single national scheme. Messages claiming a "PM Free Laptop Yojana" sending laptops to every student are usually fake.

items.title: Free Laptop Yojana 2026: फ्री लैपटॉप योजना 2026 Registration,Last Date & Latest Update
items.snippet_en: A YouTube video discussing the "Free Laptop Yojana 2026" advises students to check official websites for application deadlines as many fake links and unverified claims circulate on social media.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Scam forwards often create panic with "apply before midnight" and urgent application deadlines. It advises verifying information on official government portals.

A YouTube video mentions that some scholarship schemes for laptops have application deadlines, with one specifically mentioning October 31st, but this is for a scholarship and not a general "PM Free Laptop Yojana."

items.title: PM Laptop Scheme deadline extended to June 1, apply now to secure your device!
items.snippet_en: An article from Daily Times mentions that the Prime Minister's Youth Laptop Scheme in Pakistan extended its registration deadline to June 1, 2025. This refers to a scheme in Pakistan, not India.

items.title: Rajasthan Free Laptop Yojana Merit List PDF Download District Wise
items.snippet_en: An article on mbresult.in discusses the Rajasthan Free Laptop/Tablet Scheme 2026 and mentions that the process for preparing district-wise merit lists is underway, but does not provide a general application deadline of October 15 for a "PM Free Laptop Yojana."

An article on mpbreaking.in mentions that the financial year 2026-27 for a scheme will be completed by August 31, and subsequently by September 15, 2026. This is not directly related to a general October 15 deadline for a "PM Free Laptop Yojana."
A YouTube video by TV9 Bharatvarsh, investigating the "Students Laptop Scheme 2026," found that the website mentioned in the viral message was blocked.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Careerindia.com warns that scam forwards use non-government URLs and advises searching scheme names with "site:.gov.in" to find authentic notices.
Yojanagpt.com advises visiting the official state education department website and always confirming it ends in ".gov.in" or ".nic.in" for legitimate schemes.

items.title: प्रधानमंत्री मुफ्त लैपटॉप योजना की फर्जी खबरों के बारे में जागरूकता
items.snippet_en: The AICTE website has a notice about fake news regarding the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme," implying that unofficial websites promoting such schemes are not legitimate.

items.title: Did Government of India invite applications for free laptops? PIB Fact Check debunks social media posts
items.snippet_en: Livemint reports that the PIB Fact Check debunked claims about a "National Student Laptop Scheme 2026" and warned against fraudsters using attractive offers to lure people into sharing personal information, suggesting that unofficial websites are likely fraudulent.

A website, vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com, contains content that appears to be a promotional page for a "Free Laptop Scheme 2026" and uses a vercel.app domain, which is not an official government domain.

outputs.notes_en: The claim about a "PM Free Laptop Yojana 2026" providing free laptops to all students is false. Multiple sources, including official fact-checkers and news outlets, confirm that no such national scheme exists. The claim about an application deadline of October 15 is also not supported by evidence for a national scheme, with sources indicating such deadlines are often used in scams or refer to different, regional schemes. The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government website and is likely part of a scam, as official government websites end in .gov.in or .nic.in.
